title: Broncos release safety Taylor Rapp and sign DT Israel Antwine and OT Foster Sarell

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos release safety Taylor Rapp and sign DT Israel Antwine and OT Foster Sarell
sources.description: Well, that was quick. After signing with the Broncos just a few days ago, the Broncos have now released veteran safety Taylor Rapp along with wide receiver Kyre Duplessis and have signed defensive tackle Israel Antwine and offensive tackle Foster Sarell. This news comes from NFL Network’s lead league insider Ian Rapoport. This is a […]
